raw:
“I felt proud when I made a bookcase and every cookbook fitted on it. I’d used leftover pine for the shelves, so it was satisfying to turn that into something useful. And the top shelf was level on the first try—that was the bit I was especially pleased with. You want it straight, of course, but getting it right straightaway felt good.

Then seeing all the cookbooks on it, that was another sort of satisfaction. It wasn’t just something I’d made; it actually held everything I wanted it to hold. Funny how a shelf can give you that feeling. I work as a swimming pool caretaker, but this was something of my own I could look at and think, ‘I made that.’”
